skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand and explain the nature of environmental monitoring, its role and position in environmental management.
Apply environmental monitoring methods in practical environmental management activities.
Develop independent work skills, self-study, and creativity.
Demonstrate teamwork skills, self-reliance, and responsibility.
Analyze environmental data and interpret results.
Design and implement environmental monitoring programs.
Evaluate and report environmental monitoring results.
Ensure and control the quality of environmental monitoring.
Understand the basic concepts and requirements of environmental monitoring.
Understand the basic characteristics of environmental objects.
Use environmental indicators and indices to assess environmental conditions.
